dataset/1.sql:
-- S11A dataset grain: one source user-movie rating. UTC timestamp is typed,
-- title join is one-to-one; no genre bridge. Superset filters before GROUP BY/LIMIT.
SELECT r.user_id,r.movie_id,m.title,r.rating,
       1::bigint AS rating_count,r.rating::bigint AS rating_sum,
       (r.rated_at::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS rated_at_utc
FROM dw.v_ml_ratings r JOIN dw.v_ml_movies m ON m.movie_id=r.movie_id

dataset/2.sql:
-- Fixed catalog grain: one source movie, deliberately outside native time filter.
SELECT movie_id,title FROM dw.v_ml_movies

dataset/3.sql:
-- O4: exactly one row per UTC quarter. Never add year/month rollup rows.
SELECT calendar_year::text || ' Q' || quarter_number::text AS quarter_label,
       make_date(calendar_year,quarter_number*3-2,1) AS quarter_start,
       rating_count,rating_sum,mean_rating,
       make_date(calendar_year,quarter_number*3-2,1) IN
         (SELECT min(make_date(calendar_year,quarter_number*3-2,1)) FROM analytics.v_olap_time_rollup WHERE time_level='quarter')
       OR make_date(calendar_year,quarter_number*3-2,1) IN
         (SELECT max(make_date(calendar_year,quarter_number*3-2,1)) FROM analytics.v_olap_time_rollup WHERE time_level='quarter') AS is_boundary_partial
FROM analytics.v_olap_time_rollup WHERE time_level='quarter'

dataset/4.sql:
-- O5: one genre x UTC quarter. All windows/denominators precede display filters.
-- Approved view zero-fills before LAG; previous=0 -> NULL; threshold fixed at100.
WITH eligible AS (
 SELECT genre_name,quarter_start,
        row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY quarter_start ORDER BY qoq_pct DESC,rating_count DESC,genre_name ASC) AS growth_rank
 FROM analytics.v_olap_genre_quarter WHERE eligible_for_ranking
), full_series AS (
 SELECT v.*,e.growth_rank,
        extract(year FROM v.quarter_start)::int::text || ' Q' || extract(quarter FROM v.quarter_start)::int::text AS quarter_label
 FROM analytics.v_olap_genre_quarter v LEFT JOIN eligible e USING(genre_name,quarter_start)
)
SELECT *,CASE WHEN is_boundary_partial THEN 'Quý biên: thiếu quan sát'
              WHEN previous_is_boundary_partial THEN 'Quý trước là quý biên: không xếp hạng'
              WHEN NOT passes_fixed_100_threshold THEN 'Quý trước <100 hoặc chưa có: không xếp hạng'
              ELSE 'Đủ điều kiện xếp hạng (toàn bộ 18 genre)' END AS ranking_status,
       CASE WHEN growth_rank=1 AND qoq_pct<0 THEN 'Hạng 1: giảm ít nhất'
            WHEN growth_rank=1 THEN 'Hạng 1: tăng dương'
            WHEN growth_rank IS NULL THEN 'N/A: không xếp hạng'
            ELSE 'Đã xếp hạng' END AS rank_interpretation
FROM full_series
